test_queuedmongoobserver_started_event: test the QueuedMongoObserver started_event to create a new run document in MongoDB
test_queuedmongoobserver_heartbeat_event: test the QueuedMongoObserver heartbeat_event to update run info, captured output, and result
test_queuedmongoobserver_completed_event: test the QueuedMongoObserver completed_event to mark a run as COMPLETED with stop time
test_queuedmongoobserver_log_metrics: test the QueuedMongoObserver log_metrics to store scalar measurements in the metrics collection
test_queuedmongoobserver_artifact_event: test the QueuedMongoObserver artifact_event to store file artifacts with content type and metadata
